reference: docs/architecture/parity_pairs.md (race_finish, TS<->Dart and Dart<->Kotlin); issue #1304 section 2; decisions § 1843, § 1845, § 1856 (this file's schema convention), § 2377 (gate_crossing v1), § 2378 (race_finish v2 and its provisional constants)

general: Every reader loads this whole file and runs every case in every section below; a section a reader skips is a rule that side no longer has to keep.

A number field may instead hold the string "NaN", "Infinity" or "-Infinity" (JSON has no literal for them); readers decode those to the IEEE value. Only fields documented as 'number-or-special' carry them.
Instants are integer milliseconds relative to t0EpochMs (UTC). A reader builds the absolute instant as t0EpochMs + value. Fix times are whole seconds relative to t0EpochMs (atS).
A field documented as nullable is present with the JSON value null when absent; readers must not treat a missing key as null.
distanceToleranceM applies to every compared distance in metres; offsetToleranceMs to every compared clock offset. Every other comparison is exact.
schema.constants: FINISH_ZONE_M, MIN_COVERAGE, MIN_COVERAGE_WITH_START, START_COMMIT_M, LATE_START_AFTER_MS, LATE_START_FAR_M, EARTH_RADIUS_M, GATE_EARTH_RADIUS_M. Each reader asserts its own constants equal these (GATE_EARTH_RADIUS_M against its gate_crossing port). MIN_COVERAGE_WITH_START and START_COMMIT_M are provisional until the #1304 calibration session.
schema.origin: finishLat / finishLng: the course finish point every detector case uses. A fix's northM (number-or-special) places it northM metres due north of the finish: lat = finishLat + northM / (EARTH_RADIUS_M * PI / 180), lng = finishLng.
schema.distance: {name, a: [lat, lng], b: [lat, lng], expectM}: great-circle distance between a and b, within distanceToleranceM.
schema.zone: {name, distanceM (number-or-special), inZone: bool}: whether a fix that far from the finish is inside the finish zone. Inclusive at FINISH_ZONE_M; a non-finite distance is outside.
schema.coverage: {name, coveredM, courseDistanceM (number-or-special, nullable), met: bool}: the coverage gate. coveredM >= MIN_COVERAGE * courseDistanceM, inclusive. A course distance that is null, non-finite or <= 0 cannot gate, so it is met.
schema.detector: {name, courseDistanceM, fixes: [{northM (number-or-special), atS, coveredM (number-or-special)}], fixesAfterSettle?: [same], expect: {finalisesAtFix: int|null, finish: {atS, distanceToFinishM, coveredM}|null, candidateAtS: int|null, settleAtS: int|null}}. Build a detector for origin + courseDistanceM and offer the fixes in order. finalisesAtFix is the 0-based index of the FIRST offer that returns a finish (null when none does), and finish is that finish. Offers after it must not change the finish (Dart returns null on them, Kotlin returns the same finish again; both conform). candidateAtS is the open candidate's atS after the last fix (null when none is open, including after a finish). Then call settle (Kotlin: finaliseNow): settleAtS is the atS of what it returns, or null. When fixesAfterSettle is present, offer them after settling: the settled finish must not change.
schema.startFlag: {name, gunMs, recordingStartedMs, firstFixFromStartM (number-or-special, nullable), flagged: bool}: the late-start flag. Flagged when recordingStartedMs - gunMs > LATE_START_AFTER_MS (strictly), or when firstFixFromStartM is finite and > LATE_START_FAR_M (strictly). Both instants are on the server clock.
schema.clockOffset: {name, samples: [{sentMs, receivedMs, serverMs}], expect: {known: bool, offsetMs}}: the device-to-server clock offset estimator, fed every sample in order. A sample whose round trip (receivedMs - sentMs) is negative is ignored. Otherwise it replaces the current estimate when its round trip is <= the best so far (an equal round trip replaces: the later sample wins). The estimate is serverMs - (sentMs + roundTrip / 2). With no accepted sample, known is false and offsetMs is 0. offsetMs is compared within offsetToleranceMs, which absorbs Dart's microsecond midpoint against Kotlin's millisecond one on an odd round trip.
schema.gunTime: {name, finishMs, gunMs, offsetMs, gunTimeS: int|null}: seconds from GO to the finish, the finish moved onto the server clock by offsetMs. Integer division of the non-negative millisecond difference by 1000 (floor). Null, never clamped, when the difference is negative.
schema.chipTime: {name, finishMs, startMs, chipTimeS: int|null}: seconds from the runner's own Start to the finish, both device clock, pauses included. Floor of the non-negative millisecond difference / 1000; null, never clamped, when negative.
schema.stopOutcome: {name, candidate: {atMs, distanceToFinishM, coveredM}|null, coveredM, courseDistanceM (number-or-special, nullable), nowMs, expect: {finisherStatus, method: 'auto'|'manual'|null, finishAtMs: int|null}}: what a stop records. An open candidate is 'finished' / 'auto' at the candidate's instant; else coverage met (the coverage rule above) is 'finished' / 'manual' at nowMs, the instant the runner stopped; else 'dnf' with no method and no finish instant.
schema.resultTiming: {name, outcome: {finisherStatus, method, finishAtMs|null}, gunMs: int|null, offsetMs, startMs: int|null, recordingStartedMs: int|null, elapsedS, expect: {durationS, gunTimeS: int|null, chipTimeS: int|null}}: the timing columns of the event_results row for an outcome. startMs is the committed start (a start-line crossing, or GO for a runner already past the line), device clock, or null for the Start press. A 'finished' outcome carries gunTimeS (gunTime rule; null with no GO) and chipTimeS (chipTime rule, from startMs when it is non-null and from recordingStartedMs otherwise; null with neither; capped at gunTimeS when both exist, since a recording started before GO joins the race at GO), and durationS is the first non-null of gunTimeS, chipTimeS, elapsedS. A 'dnf' carries no gunTimeS and no chipTimeS, and durationS is elapsedS, the recording's elapsed seconds. finish_method on the row is outcome.method, so a DNF row has none.
schema.lines: race_finish v3: the detector with start and finish lines. {name, note, courseDistanceM (number-or-special), mode: 'gun'|'selfTimed', goS: int|null, goSetAfterFix: int|null, pressS: int|null, minCoverageM: number|null, startGate: G|null, finishGate: G|null, fixes: [{northM, eastM, atS, coveredM}], expect}. Positions are metres on the local plane at the origin on GATE_EARTH_RADIUS_M: lat = finishLat + northM / K, lng = finishLng + eastM / (K * cos(finishLat)), K = GATE_EARTH_RADIUS_M * PI / 180; a gate G {northM, eastM, bearingDeg, halfWidthM} is centred the same way. The finish zone is centred on the origin. goS is GO on the device clock the fixes are timed on, or null for none. When goS is non-null and goSetAfterFix is null, GO is given at construction; when goSetAfterFix is k, the detector is built with no GO and setGo(goS) is called right after fix k is offered. minCoverageM is the course's frozen lap minimum (race_session_courses.finish_min_coverage_m), handed to the detector as it is; null for none. Build the detector, offer the fixes in order, then call settle (Kotlin: finaliseNow). expect: finalisesAtFix is the index of the fix whose offer (or the setGo right after it) first returned a finish, else null, and finish is that finish; start is the detector's start after the last fix and before settle (the committed start, null while the first one is pending; a self-timed start re-armed by a backward crossing stays the start until a new forward crossing commits); candidateAtS is the open zone candidate's atS after the last fix; settle is what settle returns. A finish or settle is {atMs, coveredM, distanceToFinishM, detection: 'gate'|'zone', gapped, start: {atMs, coveredM, kind: 'line'|'go'}|null}: atMs is the interpolated crossing instant rounded to the millisecond (exact), coveredM within distanceToleranceM, distanceToFinishM within distanceToleranceM (a line finish's lateral offset from the line centre; a zone finish's haversine distance on EARTH_RADIUS_M). timing, when settle is non-null, is raceResultTiming for a 'finished' / 'auto' outcome at settle.atMs with gunMs = goS * 1000 (null when goS is), offsetMs 0, startMs = settle.start.atMs (null when there is none), recordingStartedMs = pressS * 1000, elapsedS 0; null when settle is. The rules themselves are in decisions § 2378 and § 2472; each case's note carries its hand computation.

distance.name: one degree of latitude is ~111.2 km
a tenth of a degree of longitude at 51.5 N

zone.name: exactly on the 30 m edge counts
a hair outside the edge does not

detector.name: the finish time is the closest fix, not the first in-zone fix
the first strictly farther fix finalises
nothing finalises while the runner is still closing
a fix outside the zone is never a candidate
a fix 30 m out is a candidate and one 30.1 m out is not
settle finalises an open approach on its closest fix and takes no more fixes
a tie keeps the earlier fix and does not finalise
jitter outside the zone before reaching it changes nothing
a fix jittering out of the zone ends the approach on the best so far
jitter inside the zone that is not farther keeps it open
a loop course does not finish on its start
a loop course passing the finish below 90% does not finish, the pass above it does
an out-and-back course finishes on the return only
the coverage gate is inclusive in the stream
a non-finite fix is ignored, not taken as leaving the zone
a non-finite fix before any candidate opens nothing
kt: closest approach inside the zone, settled when the distance grows
kt: jitter out of the zone settles at the best fix seen inside it, and a fix back in cannot move it
kt: a loop course does not finish at the start or on an early pass
kt: an out-and-back past the line on the way out finishes only on the way back
kt: settle on a pending closest approach

one millisecond past five minutes is flagged
five minutes and a second after GO is flagged
a first fix 201 m from the start is flagged
a first fix exactly 200 m from the start is not
an unknown first-fix distance does not flag
a NaN first-fix distance does not flag
an infinite first-fix distance does not flag
a recording started before GO is not late

measured against the midpoint of the round trip

the shortest round trip is kept
a later, shorter round trip replaces the estimate
an equal round trip replaces: the later sample wins
a sample whose clock ran backwards is ignored
a backwards sample after a good one leaves the estimate

an odd round trip lands within the tolerance on either clock resolution

is omitted, not clamped, when negative

an offset that moves the finish after GO keeps it

a finish at Start is zero
is omitted, not clamped, when negative
five milliseconds negative is omitted too

90% covered without an approach is a manual finish at the stop
exactly 90% covered is a manual finish
under 90% covered is a DNF with no method and no finish instant

a late Start splits gun from chip, and the offset moves only the gun
no GO on record: duration is the chip time
no GO and no Start: duration is the elapsed recording

lines.name: a warm-up past the line before GO does not commit the start
lines.note: Loop: start and finish lines both at the origin, bearing 0, so s = northM. Fix 1 crosses forward at f = 20/40 = 0.5, t = 5 s, before GO (100 s): ignored for the start, and no finish counts before GO. GO falls between fix 3 (90 s, s -30, 950 m) and fix 4 (110 s, s -10, 970 m) at f = 0.5: s(GO) = -20 < 0, so the runner is behind the line, covered at GO = 960. Fix 5 crosses both lines at f = 0.5: t = 112 s, covered 980. Finish first on the tie: no committed start, so coverage from GO, 980 - 960 = 20 < 900. Then the start crossing is pending; fix 6 (1040 >= 980 + 50) commits it. Fix 8 crosses at t = 402 s, covered 1980: 1980 - 980 = 1000 >= 0.6 * 1000. Gun 402 - 100 = 302, chip 402 - 112 = 290.

lines.name: a recording started after GO already past the line starts at GO
lines.note: GO (-60 s) is before the first fix, so the side at GO is the first fix's: s = +40 >= 0, start = GO with the first fix's covered 0. Fixes 1 -> 2 are 280 s apart (more than rejectGapS 60): no crossing. Fix 3 crosses forward at f = 0.5: t = 292 s, covered 970 >= 0.6 * 1000 from 0. Gun 292 + 60 = 352; chip from GO, 352, not from the Start press (294 s).

lines.name: a wave runner crossing 90 s after GO is timed from the crossing
lines.note: Start line 1000 m south of the finish line, both bearing 0. GO at 0 s lands on fix 1 (f = 60/60 = 1): s(GO) = -200, behind the line, covered at GO 0. Fix 3 crosses the start line at f = 0.5: t = 90 s, covered 200; fix 4 (260 >= 250) commits it. Fix 6 crosses the finish line at f = 0.5: t = 382 s, covered 1200, 1000 from the start. Gun 382; chip 382 - 90 = 292, where the Start press would have given 442 capped to 382.

lines.name: a GO learned late replays the held fixes to the same answer
lines.note: Start line 1000 m south of the finish line, both bearing 0. GO at 0 s lands on fix 1 (f = 60/60 = 1): s(GO) = -200, behind the line, covered at GO 0. Fix 3 crosses the start line at f = 0.5: t = 90 s, covered 200; fix 4 (260 >= 250) commits it. Fix 6 crosses the finish line at f = 0.5: t = 382 s, covered 1200, 1000 from the start. Gun 382; chip 382 - 90 = 292, where the Start press would have given 442 capped to 382. Here GO reaches the detector only after fix 4 is offered: fixes 0-4 are held and replayed, and setGo returns nothing because the replay finalises nothing.

lines.name: a course turning within 50 m of the start still commits, by covered distance
lines.note: Start line at the origin, no finish line (zone only). GO (-5 s) is before the first fix: s = -10, behind, covered at GO 0. Fix 1 crosses at f = 0.5: t = 2 s, covered 10. The runner turns east 10 m past the line and s stays +10, but fix 3's covered 80 >= 10 + 50 commits the start. No fix is in the zone with coverage: no finish.

lines.name: a hairpin on the start line voids the first crossing and the next one commits
lines.note: Start line at the origin. Fix 1 crosses forward at t = 2 s, covered 10; fix 2 crosses back at f = 0.5, t = 6 s, covered 30 < 10 + 50, so the pending start is void. Fix 3 crosses forward at t = 10 s, covered 50; fix 4 (130 >= 100) commits it.

lines.name: a runner who steps back behind the start line and waits is timed from the crossing they finally make
lines.note: Start line at the origin, no finish line, GO at -5 s (before the first fix, s -10: behind). Fix 1 crosses forward at t = 2 s, covered 10; fix 2 crosses back at t = 6 s, covered 30 < 60, voiding it. The runner walks about behind the line and fix 3's covered 60 would have committed the first crossing had the backward one not voided it. Fix 5 crosses forward at f = 0.5: t = 42 s, covered 90; fix 6 (170 >= 140) commits it.

lines.name: standing on the line at GO starts at GO, and the 60 % gate applies from it
lines.note: Both lines at the origin, GO at 0 s on the first fix, which is on the line: s(GO) = 0, and a fix on the line counts as past it (as gate_crossing counts it), so the start is GO with covered 0. Moving off the line forward is no crossing (s was not < 0), so read as 'behind' this runner would never start. Fix 3 crosses at f = 0.5: t = 302 s, covered 660. A track that under-measures the 1000 m loop by a third still clears 0.6 * 1000 from a committed start, where the 90 % gate (900) would refuse it. Gun 302, chip 302.

lines.name: a 60 m sprint finishes on the crossing after its start commits, even between the same two fixes
lines.note: Start line 60 m south of the finish line, course 60 m, GO at -5 s (before the first fix, s -10: behind, covered 0). Fix 1 crosses the start at t = 2 s, covered 10 (pending). Fixes 1 -> 2 (12 s and 60 m apart: gapped) cross the finish line at f = 50/60: t = 4 + 12 * 50/60 = 14 s, covered 20 + 50 = 70. By then the start has covered 60 >= 50, so it is committed and the crossing counts: 70 - 10 = 60 >= 0.6 * 60. Gun 14 + 5 = 19, chip 14 - 2 = 12.

lines.name: self-timed: a start reversed by a backward crossing does not count
lines.note: Start line 1000 m south. Fix 1 crosses it forward (t = 2 s, covered 10); fix 2 crosses back with 30 covered, inside the 50 m commit distance, which voids it. The runner then goes round the end of the line: fix 2 -> 3 passes s = 0 at u = 40 * 10/15 = 26.7 > 15, no crossing. Fix 6 crosses the finish line forward with 1180 m covered, but there is no start to measure from, so it does not count.

lines.name: a finish crossing just before GO does not count, even with no course distance to gate on
lines.note: Course distance unknown (NaN), so coverage cannot gate. GO at 3 s falls between fix 0 (0 s) and fix 1 (4 s) at f = 0.75: s on the start line (1000 m south) is +1010 >= 0, so the start is GO, covered 0.75 * 40 = 30. The same pair crosses the finish line at t = 2 s, before GO: no finish. Fix 1 is in the zone, but fix 2 leaves it, so settle has nothing.

lines.name: a gun-mode loop with no course distance does not finish on its own start
lines.note: Both lines at the origin, course distance unknown (NaN), so coverage cannot gate. GO at 0 s on the first fix (s -10: behind). Fix 1 crosses both lines at t = 2 s. On a tie a gun race takes the start first: it is pending, so the finish has no base and does not count, which the unknown distance alone could not have stopped (it would have been a 2 s race). Fix 2 (90 >= 10 + 50) commits the start.

lines.name: a finish-line crossing before GO does not count, even without a start line
lines.note: Finish line at the origin, no start line, GO at 100 s. Fix 1 crosses the finish line at f = 0.5, t = 2 s, covered 960 >= 900 from the Start press, but before GO: no finish. Fix 4 crosses at t = 302 s, covered 1920: a finish, coverage from the Start press as v1 (no start line). Gun 302 - 100 = 202; chip from the press 302, capped at 202.

lines.name: a loop course with a 90 % warm-up before the start does not finish at the start (B3)
lines.note: Loop, both lines at the origin. 950 m of warm-up before GO (610 s). GO between fix 1 (600 s, s -30, 950) and fix 2 (620 s, s -10, 970) at f = 0.5: s(GO) = -20, covered at GO 960. Fix 3 crosses both lines at t = 622 s, covered 980: the finish is taken first, with no start, so coverage runs from GO: 20 < 900 (from the Start press it would be 980 >= 900, the v1 false finish). The start is then pending, and fix 4 (in the zone, 1005 < 1030) cannot finish while it is. Settle finds no candidate.

lines.name: a parallel pass beside the finish late in the course does not finish (B2)
lines.note: Start line 1000 m south, finish line at the origin, both bearing 0, half-width 15. Start crossed at t = 2 s (covered 10), committed at fix 2. Fixes 3-6 pass 20 m east of the finish line: fix 4 -> 5 crosses s = 0 at u = 20 > 15, so no crossing. Fixes 4 and 5 are inside the 30 m zone (20.62 and 25 m) with 950 and 970 m since the start >= 900, but with a finish line the zone decides only on settle, and fix 6 (40.3 m) leaves it, which clears the candidate (v1 would have finished at fix 4 on fix 5). Fix 8 crosses the line centre at t = 402 s, covered 1200: 1190 >= 600.

lines.name: a course crossing the finish line mid-race below the with-start share finishes only at the end
lines.note: Both lines at the origin. Start at t = 2 s (covered 10), committed at fix 2. Fix 4 crosses the line forward at t = 202 s, covered 410: 400 < 600, no finish. Fix 7 crosses at t = 502 s, covered 1010: 1000 >= 600. A course of three or more equal laps through the line is not this: its crossing at (k-1)/k >= 0.6 of the distance would finish a lap early, which is why multi-lap courses are out of scope and #1307 gives a self-crossing course no gate auto-finish (decisions § 2378).

lines.name: Stop inside the zone without crossing the line finishes at the closest fix on settle
lines.note: Start 1000 m south (crossed at 2 s, covered 10, committed at fix 2), finish line at the origin. Fixes 3-5 approach and stop short of it, all inside the zone with >= 900 m since the start: closest is fix 4, 12 m out (haversine on R 6371000 of a point placed on R 6371008.8: 11.99998). Fix 5 is farther, which in v1 would finalise; with a finish line nothing finalises until settle, which takes fix 4: 384 s, covered 1178, from the line start. Gun 384, chip 382.

lines.name: self-timed: an aborted attempt then a full one is timed from the second start
lines.note: No GO. Start line 1000 m south, finish at the origin. Fix 1 crosses the start forward at t = 4 s (covered 20), committed by fix 2 (320 >= 70); the runner turns back and fix 4 crosses it backward at f = 10/20 = 0.5, t = 102 s, which re-arms it without clearing it. Fix 6 crosses forward at t = 202 s, covered 640, and fix 7 (1620 >= 690) commits it, replacing the first. Fix 8 crosses the finish at t = 502 s, covered 1640: 1000 from the start >= 600. No gun time; chip 502 - 202 = 300, which is also the duration.

lines.name: self-timed: no finish counts without a start crossing
lines.note: The recording starts past the start line and never crosses it. Fix 2 crosses the finish line forward, and fixes 1-3 are in the zone, but with no start there is nothing to measure coverage from, so neither counts.

lines.name: self-timed with no start line finishes nothing automatically
lines.note: A self-timed race needs a start line. Without one the v1 closest approach does not apply: the zone pass with 980-1005 m covered finishes nothing, and settle neither.

lines.name: a finish line without a start line times from the Start press with the 90 % gate
lines.note: No start line: the start is the Start press and coverage counts from 0. Fix 1 crosses the finish line at t = 2 s, covered 870 < 0.9 * 1000. Fix 4 crosses at f = 0.5, t = 302 s, covered 1120 >= 900. Gun 302, chip from the press 302.

lines.name: a line with no width is no line: the zone finishes as in v1
lines.note: A half-width of 0 is not a usable line, and with no start line either the detector is v1: fix 1 (4 m, 996 >= 900) is the closest; fix 2 is farther and finalises at fix 1. Distance 4 * 6371000 / 6371008.8 = 3.999994.

lines.name: the wrong direction through the finish line does not finish
lines.note: Heading south through a line whose travel is north: the crossing between fixes 0 and 1 is backward and never a finish. Both fixes are in the zone, but fix 2 leaves it, so settle has no candidate.

lines.name: nothing finishes before GO
lines.note: GO is at 1000 s. The start crossing at 2 s and the finish crossing at 402 s (covered 1200) are both before it, and so is every zone fix: no finish, no start, and settle has no candidate.

lines.name: a gun race whose GO never arrives finishes nothing automatically
lines.note: The wave runner's track with no GO ever set: the fixes are held for a GO that never comes, and settle releases them with no finish.

lines.name: self-timed on a loop whose two lines coincide finishes at the end of the lap, not on its own start
lines.note: Both lines at the origin, no GO. Fix 1 crosses both at f = 0.5: t = 2 s, covered 20. The finish is taken first on the tie and has no start yet, so it does not count; the start crossing then becomes the pending start, committed by fix 2 (100 >= 70). Fix 4 crosses both again at t = 302 s, covered 1020: the finish, taken first, is measured from the start at 2 s, 1000 >= 600. Were the start taken first it would be its own start, coverage 0, and the lap would never finish. Chip 302 - 2 = 300.

lines.name: re-time: the same track gives the same result in all three ports
lines.note: Start line 1000 m south, finish line at the origin, GO at 300 s. Warm-up crossings of the start line at 58.06 s (forward) and 170 s (backward) are before GO and ignored. GO between fix 4 (290 s, s -20, 520) and fix 5 (310 s, s -15, 525) at f = 0.5: s(GO) = -17.5, covered at GO 522.5. Fix 7 crosses forward at f = 0.5: 342 s, covered 540. Fix 8 crosses back at f = 5/8: 344 + 0.625 * 2 = 345.25 s, covered 545 + 0.625 * 8 = 550 < 590: void. Fix 9 crosses forward at f = 0.5: 347 s, covered 556; fix 10 (616 >= 606) commits it. Fixes 11-13 pass 20 m east of the finish line (no crossing, u = 20 > 15) and leave the zone. Fix 13 -> 14 crosses backward (ignored). Fix 14 -> 15 crosses forward at f = 35/60: 760 + 15 * 35/60 = 768.75 s, covered 1600 + 35 = 1635, 15 s apart and a 60 m hop, so gapped. 1635 - 556 = 1079 >= 600. Gun floor(468.75) = 468, chip floor(421.75) = 421.

lines.name: re-time: the same track with GO learned late gives the same result
lines.note: Start line 1000 m south, finish line at the origin, GO at 300 s. Warm-up crossings of the start line at 58.06 s (forward) and 170 s (backward) are before GO and ignored. GO between fix 4 (290 s, s -20, 520) and fix 5 (310 s, s -15, 525) at f = 0.5: s(GO) = -17.5, covered at GO 522.5. Fix 7 crosses forward at f = 0.5: 342 s, covered 540. Fix 8 crosses back at f = 5/8: 344 + 0.625 * 2 = 345.25 s, covered 545 + 0.625 * 8 = 550 < 590: void. Fix 9 crosses forward at f = 0.5: 347 s, covered 556; fix 10 (616 >= 606) commits it. Fixes 11-13 pass 20 m east of the finish line (no crossing, u = 20 > 15) and leave the zone. Fix 13 -> 14 crosses backward (ignored). Fix 14 -> 15 crosses forward at f = 35/60: 760 + 15 * 35/60 = 768.75 s, covered 1600 + 35 = 1635, 15 s apart and a 60 m hop, so gapped. 1635 - 556 = 1079 >= 600. Gun floor(468.75) = 468, chip floor(421.75) = 421. GO reaches the detector after fix 12; the held fixes replay to the same answer.

lines.name: 3 equal laps finish at the end of lap 3, not before
lines.note: Lap track: start and finish lines both at the origin facing north, 15 m each side; the runner starts 50 m behind them at (n -50, e 0) and runs a 400 m rectangle (n 100 / e 50 / n -50) at 5 m/s, one fix per corner. Each lap crosses both lines on the north leg at f = 1/3: lap j at t = 10 + 80 j s, covered 50 + 400 j. Host GO at 0 s with the runner behind the line; the first crossing (10 s, covered 50) is the start, taken before the finish on the tie and committed by fix 1 (150 >= 100). D = 1200, L = 400: the frozen minimum is max(0.6 * 1200, 1200 - 200) = 1000. Lap 2 passes 800 m from the start < 1000: no finish (under v2's 0.6 share it finished at lap 2). Lap 3 (fix 13) crosses at t = 250 s, covered 1250: 1200 >= 1000. Gun 250, chip 250-10 = 240.

lines.name: 4 equal laps finish at the end of lap 4, not before
lines.note: Lap track: start and finish lines both at the origin facing north, 15 m each side; the runner starts 50 m behind them at (n -50, e 0) and runs a 400 m rectangle (n 100 / e 50 / n -50) at 5 m/s, one fix per corner. Each lap crosses both lines on the north leg at f = 1/3: lap j at t = 10 + 80 j s, covered 50 + 400 j. Host GO at 0 s with the runner behind the line; the first crossing (10 s, covered 50) is the start, taken before the finish on the tie and committed by fix 1 (150 >= 100). D = 1600, L = 400: the frozen minimum is max(0.6 * 1600, 1600 - 200) = 1400. Lap 3 passes 1200 m from the start < 1400: no finish (under v2's 0.6 share it finished at lap 3).
